apps.localizedDescription:
Revision 6 adds Spanish and Simplified Chinese source mode, signed translation-pack downloads with manual control, and fixes for settings entries, dialogs and Home Screen shortcuts. Automatic translation updates default off. Fully close and reopen BYD to apply downloaded translations. Widgets retain bundled translations. Spanish is a draft; some Chinese artwork/live content remain.

Fixes a startup/login crash when widget image storage is unavailable. Resolves accessible signed app groups independently of the app ID and safely skips unavailable image caches. Includes all Revision 4 widgets, translations and optional walk-up features. Keep App Extensions when installing. Confirmation on affected phones is still pending.

Revision 4 restores Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, localizes their text, fixes widget control requests outside China’s time zone, and restores missing dashboard tile icons. Select Keep App Extensions when installing. BYD and its four extensions use five App IDs. Open BYD after updating and allow time for widgets to refresh.

Unofficial localized BYD 9.16.0. Choose English, Arabic or Russian in Me → Settings → Language. Hide Discover, Mall and Service individually. My Car uses the original car icon. Includes dashboard Bluetooth badges.

Revision 3 adds optional Walk-up unlock, walk-away locking, calibration, background location and movement support, and local test logs. Find it in Me → Settings → Walk-up unlock. A working activated BYD Bluetooth key is required. Automatic actions and background support are off by default for new users. Calibrate on your own phone, then test both foreground and locked-screen behavior. Background support may increase battery use.

Known beta issue: one iPhone XS showed inconsistent RSSI, persisting after an iOS update. An unintended indoor unlock was reported during earlier testing. Cause unresolved; hardware failure is not established. Turn this feature off if near/far readings overlap or unintended actions occur. The tested module worked on a stock iPhone 12 Pro Max, including locked/background cycles; all devices and overnight operation are not validated.

Requires configured AltStore Classic and reachable AltServer for install, update and refresh with your own Apple account. Some Chinese artwork and live content remain; the profile page may be blank. Apple-restricted capabilities such as Wallet car keys and push notifications are not promised. Not affiliated with or endorsed by BYD.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds Spanish and Simplified Chinese, signed translation-pack downloads with manual control, and fixes missing settings entries, dialog text and Home Screen shortcut titles. Automatic translation updates are off by default. Keep all app extensions when installing. Some translations/artwork remain incomplete; Spanish is a draft.

Fixes a startup/login crash when widget image storage is unavailable. Resolves accessible signed app groups independently of the app ID and safely skips unavailable image caches. Includes all Revision 4 widgets, translations and optional walk-up features. Keep App Extensions when installing. Confirmation on affected phones is still pending.

Restores localized Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, fixes widget command time-zone handling and missing tile icons, and corrects clipped mileage. Choose Keep App Extensions in AltStore. Open BYD after updating to refresh widgets. Includes the existing optional walk-up beta; its known XS proximity limitation remains.

Public beta: adds optional Walk-up unlock and walk-away locking with calibration, background location/movement support and local test logs. Off by default for new users. Tested on a stock iPhone 12 Pro Max, including locked/background cycles. Known issue: inconsistent RSSI and unintended indoor unlocking on one XS; cause unresolved. Read the setup and test notes before enabling. Update your existing app using the same Apple account.

Fixes missing Bluetooth badges on supported dashboard controls when the car is connected. Adds the existing BYD badge PNG at the resource path used by the dashboard. Bluetooth connection checks, control logic, translations and other app code are unchanged. Update your existing installation through AltStore.

First public beta: English/Arabic/Russian language selection, configurable bottom tabs, and My Car icon. Includes existing launch, network and post-login fixes. AltStore runtime compatibility awaits independent testing.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: BYD uses Bluetooth to control your vehicle, activate ETC toll devices, control smart devices and connect satellite communication equipment.
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: BYD uses Bluetooth to control your vehicle, activate ETC toll devices, control smart devices and connect satellite communication equipment.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: BYD uses the camera for photos and videos in posts and adviser chats, QR login, profile photos, issue and refund images, and AR vehicle recognition.
privacy.NSContactsUsageDescription: BYD uses contacts to choose a phone number when adding an authorized user.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: BYD uses Face ID instead of your operation password to authorize vehicle controls.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: BYD uses your local network to mirror the phone app to a tablet.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: BYD uses location for maps, finding your car and nearby places, saved places, posts, roadside assistance, adviser chats, owner and purchase services, drone positioning and satellite coordinates. Optional walk-up unlock also uses location in the background to assist Bluetooth detection; that feature does not store or upload coordinates. It may increase battery use.
privacy.NSLocationTemporaryUsageDescriptionDicti: BYD needs your precise location to show your position accurately on the map.; BYD needs your precise location to save your current position as a favorite.; BYD needs precise location permission to read the name of the connected Wi-Fi network.; BYD needs precise location permission to read the name of the connected Wi-Fi network.; BYD needs your precise location to assist positioning when remotely controlling the vehicle drone.
privacy.NSLocationUsageDescription: BYD uses location for maps, finding your car and nearby places, saved places, posts, roadside assistance, adviser chats, owner and purchase services, drone positioning and satellite coordinates.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BYD uses location for maps, finding your car and nearby places, saved places, posts, roadside assistance, adviser chats, owner and purchase services, drone positioning and satellite coordinates. Optional walk-up unlock also uses location in the background to assist Bluetooth detection; that feature does not store or upload coordinates. It may increase battery use.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: BYD uses the microphone for videos in posts and customer service chats, and for satellite calls.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Optional walk-up unlock uses motion to detect movement and briefly speed up Bluetooth detection. Movement is processed on this iPhone; optional diagnostics record detection events.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: BYD accesses photos and videos for posts, QR login, your profile, adviser chats, sharing, issue and refund images, saving remote-camera captures, and custom vehicle wallpapers.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BYD accesses photos and videos for posts, QR login, your profile, adviser chats, sharing, issue and refund images, saving remote-camera captures, and custom vehicle wallpapers.
privacy.NSSiriUsageDescription: Some BYD data is sent to Apple to process your Siri requests. Without permission, Siri cannot open the BYD app.
